law: Signposts allow you to record meaningful information about the duration of your app’s tasks using the same subsystems and categories that you use for logging.
Use to create signposted intervals in your code, and then use Instruments’ instrument to record those intervals as you run your app and perform the actions to measure.

also provides functionality to signpost a closure, and to emit individual signposts that don’t have a duration that you can use to highlight points of interest, such as when the user taps a button or performs a specific gesture.
